title: RareBench Dataset Construction Pipeline and Dual-Track Clinical Evaluation Protocol

nodes.label:
Public Rare Disease Repositories
MME 40/17, LIRICAL 370/252, HMS 88/39, RAMEDIS 624/63
1,122 Clinical Cases across 362 Rare Diseases

PUMCH Clinical EHR Cohort
1,650 Peking Union Medical College Hospital Records
1,183 Rare Disease + 467 Common Disease Cases

Clinical Data De-identification & Review
Automated PII Scrubbing Monitored by Senior Physicians
Filters Cases with < 3 Phenotypes or Imprecise Diagnoses

Clinical Case Quality Verified?
Verifies Complete Auxiliary Diagnostics & Definitive Gold Diagnosis
Ensures Robust Ground-Truth Phenotype Mapping

Incomplete / Ambiguous EHR Discard Sink
Excludes Truncated Records or Unverified Diagnostic Claims
Guarantees High-Confidence Ground Truth across Cohorts

Multi-Task Cohort Partitioning
Task 1: 87 EHRs (34 Diseases); Task 2: 33 EHRs (ALS, PNH, MSA)
Task 3: 527 EHRs (77 Diseases); Task 4: 2,185 Cases (421 Diseases)

Integrated Rare Disease Knowledge Graph
HPO Hierarchy, OMIM, Orphanet & CCRD Cross-Links
17,232 Phenotypes, 9,260 Diseases, 21,505 Relations

RareBench Frozen Multi-Task Suite
Standardized Diagnostic Benchmark Partitioned into 4 Distinct Tasks
Preserves Exact KDD 2024 Table 1 Empirical Counts

IC-Weighted Random Walk Retrieval
Information Content-Weighted Node2vec Embeddings (256D)
Retrieves Top-3 Phenotypically Similar Exemplars for Task 4

Specialist Clinical Prompt Assembly
Defines Rare Disease Specialist Role & Task Directives
Assembles Zero-Shot, CoT, or Dynamic 3-Shot Contexts

Foundation Model Clinical Reasoning
Evaluates 11 Commercial API & Open-Source LLMs
Generates Extracted Entities or Top-10 Diagnostic Candidates

Diagnostic Task Evaluation Routing?
Extraction & Screening (Tasks 1 & 2) vs Differential Diagnosis (Tasks 3 & 4)
Directs Outputs to Task-Specific Evaluation Protocols

Entity Extraction & Screening Evaluation
Task 1: Precision, Recall, F1 for PTE, GEE, and GES Matching
Task 2: Diagnostic Recall Broken Down by ALS, PNH, and MSA

Ranked Differential Diagnosis Scoring
Evaluates Top-k Hit Rates at k = 1, 3, 10 and Overall Median Rank
Verifies Target Gold Disease within Model's Top-10 Predictions

Diagnostic Misclassification & Miss Sink
Tracks Non-Hits Beyond Top-10 and Hallucinated Disease Entities
Provides Error Profiling: Entity Extraction vs Differential Reasoning

RareBench Comprehensive Diagnostic Report
Reports Micro/Macro F1 for Task 1, Disease Recalls for Task 2
and Top-1/3/10 Accuracies & Median Ranks for Tasks 3 & 4
